ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'lat') at MapView/Array.map (bundle.js:175501:39 / 175500:28). Brokerage bookings converted to shipment-shaped rows for /tracking are missing lat/lng on origin/dest so MapView crashes when iterating markers.

action_items: Fix Tracking MapView crash: guard against undefined coords or fill default lat/lng (city geocode or 0,0 with marker skip) when converting brokerage_bookings → shipment rows in pages/Tracking.jsx. The list/search/omni-search work; only the map markers crash.
Optional: add an ErrorBoundary around MapView so a single bad row doesn't blow up the whole /tracking page.
critical_code_review_comments: cash_flow.py _live_position uses synchronous-style aggregation correctly with async motor — good. AR factorable at flat 85% is a reasonable default but should be config-driven if a real factor with 90% is connected.
_shipper_credit_score is deterministic via SHA-256 — fine for MVP; flagged in docstring that this is a stub until D&B key is wired. No PII concern.

Workflow auto-route hook in orisei_workflow.py mark_stage swallows exceptions with logger.warning — defensive, but currently any silent failure leaves no proposal. Consider surfacing via a dedicated 'hook_errors' collection so QA can spot regressions.
Tracking.jsx merges brokerage_bookings into the shipment list without enriching with geo coords — MapView assumes every row has origin.lat/lng. Either enrich on the server or guard on client.
DynamicDiscount carrier_pitch hardcodes avg_carrier=1050 in /api/cash-flow/dynamic-discount — should ideally use actual avg from waiting_carriers_usd / estimated_carrier_count.

rca of the issue: Tracking MapView crash RCA: when /api/brokerage/margins (or /api/brokerage/bookings) rows are converted into shipment-shaped objects inside Tracking.jsx load(), the resulting objects lack the origin.lat / origin.lng (and dest.*) keys that ocean/parcel/TL shipments have. MapView's marker render does an Array.map over all shipments and reads `.origin.lat` directly — undefined for the booking-shaped rows → TypeError. Mitigation: in Tracking.jsx, either (a) geocode origin_city/state and dest_city/state when constructing rows, (b) supply sentinel coords + skip-marker flag, or (c) filter shipments with valid coords before passing to MapView. Reproduction: login via Quick Sign In, navigate to /tracking — red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay appears immediately after data fetch.
